mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 1.0%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (exceeding 0.3 percentage points over a 3-month window) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions and weakening corporate earnings prospects, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal a broad-based economic contraction, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST < 1750 and INDPRO < 106.

mechanism_narrative: In a demand contraction regime (as indicated by real GDP below $19.7 trillion in 2017 dollars), weak retail sales (RSAFS below 670,000 million dollars) signal deteriorating consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 19700 and RSAFS < 670000.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 106 (index) signals weakening manufacturing activity and slowing economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 106.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1700 thousand units indicate a severe housing market downturn, which negatively impacts consumer wealth and construction sector earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1700.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS above 150,000 thousand) signals strong employment growth and rising consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 150000.
